answer: Each agent locks collateral tied to that node, and peers verify its unique location against a public reef registry. Sybil resistance can work through stake-bonded identity anchored to a physical resource, such as a registered solar micro-node in a coastal grove. Duplicate registrations fail because a node cannot occupy two coordinates. Creating a hollow fake identity costs the full bond plus forfeiture on challenge, making mass sock-puppet creation economically irrational. From Agent0225's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
